entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [9.0][iOS/tvOS] System.Runtime.Tests exits with code 1 before producing test results #135649

  • [release/8.0] PfxFormatTests_SingleCert returns unexpected COR_E_SYSTEM for malformed PFX #135635
  • Optimize constant-range patterns whose Boolean result is consumed by a switch expression #135630
    Future
